info.title: API.SH: LandWatch
info.description: The LandWatch API from API.SH: public LandWatch data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A land broker's or seller's profile: name, company, description, website, license, phone numbers and office address (for businesses), logo, portrait, member since, certifications, awards, social links, listing statistics, their current listings and recently sold listings. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/landwatch-agent

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The broker id instead of a link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Land market numbers for a county (or a state, region or city): properties for sale, total acres for sale, median lot size, median list price, median price per acre and median days on market, plus listing counts by city, property type and other filters, coordinates, county FIPS codes and LandWatch's summary of the area.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/landwatch-county

parameters.description: A landwatch.com search page instead of state and county.

get.description:
One LandWatch listing: title, types, price, acres, beds, baths, home size, listing date, last update, MLS and parcel ids, address with county FIPS, region and coordinates, highlights, summary, full description, directions, price and acreage history, insights (price drops, versus county), county market benchmarks (median price, price per acre, acres, days on market), amenities by group, all photos, virtual tour, video, attachments, auction details, the broker (company, profile, website, licence, office phone and address, listing count) and the broker's other listings. A private seller's phone and address are left out. Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/landwatch-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A landwatch.com listing link (.../pid/<id>). Or give `id`.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. state), instead of `id`/`url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
US land, ranches, farms and rural homes for sale on LandWatch by state, county or city, with property type, price, acreage, home size, beds, baths, residence, status (including sold and off-market), owner financing and sort, or any LandWatch search link. Each result has id, link, title, types, price, price per acre, recent price change, acres, beds, baths, home size, address, county, coordinates, status, auction and sale dates, media flags, photos, summary and the listing broker (name, company, office phone, profile). 25 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/landwatch-search

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name (with `state`, instead of a county).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Property type: farms-ranches, hunting-property, recreational-property, homesites, undeveloped-land, waterfront-property, lakefront-property, riverfront-property, timberland, horse-property, commercial-property, house.

parameters.name: residence
parameters.description: with: only properties with a home; without: only land without one.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated listing statuses to include: available, under-contract, off-market, sold (default: what the site shows, available and under contract).

parameters.name: owner_financing
parameters.description: true: only listings offering owner financing.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of the filters: a landwatch.com search link, used with all its filters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The places LandWatch suggests for what was typed: cities, counties, regions, states and ZIP codes, each with its id, type, state id and search path.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/landwatch-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place name or ZIP code.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
